_note: How marching columns look on the 3D maps (the Whole Yard and the 3D Patch). Visual only: nothing here changes travel times or any rule. Tune them live in the test scene (/?test), then Copy changes. Each entry: value, min, max, step, unit, and what it does.

workerSize.label: Worker size
workerSize.note: How big a worker is drawn in a Whole Yard column, before the zoom grows it.

soldierSize.label: Soldier size
soldierSize.note: How big a soldier is drawn in a Whole Yard column.

spacing.label: Gap between ants
spacing.note: Distance from one ant to the next along the trail.

wobble.label: Side-to-side spread
wobble.note: How far ants stray either side of the trail line. Small, so the column walks on its line (Marz, 4 Nov 2026). Was 0.6.

stride.label: Stride
stride.note: Distance walked per leg cycle. Too short and the legs blur, too long and the feet slide.

density.label: Ants drawn per party
density.note: A column draws this × the square root of the party, so a small party still reads as a trail (Marz, 4 Nov 2026: 3 ants felt empty). 3 Workers → 17 ants, 170 → 130. Was 3.

minAnts.label: Fewest ants in a column
minAnts.note: Even a party of one shows at least this many.

maxAnts.label: Most ants in a column
maxAnts.note: A party's column never shows more ants than this (swarms are separate: 40 to 400).

trailShare.label: Longest column
trailShare.note: A column never covers more than this share of its trail, so far out, where ants are drawn big, it shows fewer.

growPatch.label: Grow at Patch zoom
growPatch.note: How much bigger ants get as the camera pulls back to a whole patch, so a column still reads.

growRegion.label: Grow at Region zoom
growRegion.note: Extra growth further out, at the Region zoom.

gap.label: Gap between rows
gap.note: Distance between rows of ants in a 3D Patch column (an ant is 0.36 long).

laneWidth.label: Lane width
laneWidth.note: Distance between side-by-side lanes in a big column.

wobble.label: Sway
wobble.note: How much each ant sways as it walks.

stride.label: Stride
stride.note: Distance walked per leg cycle on the 3D Patch.

soldierSize.label: Soldier size
soldierSize.note: Soldiers next to workers on the 3D Patch.
